sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man with short dark brown side-swept hair/brows and small dark moustache only, clean chin. Large dark leather-like safety goggles with two round dark lenses fully covering eyes. White broad-lapel lab coat, navy pointed shirt, brown ribbed round-neck sweater. Blue backdrop, restrained closed mouth. Preserve goggles/hair/moustache/brows/clothing/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short dark hair beneath grey flat newsboy cap, brows, fine round black glasses covering eyes, dark moustache plus short chin goatee. Dark brown coat, blue-grey V knitted vest, high pale grey buttoned shirt. Serious closed mouth and blue background. Preserve cap/glasses/hair/brows/moustache/goatee/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal man, short combed side-part white-grey hair/brows and broad white-grey moustache only, clean chin. Dark charcoal fine-pinstripe jacket, grey pointed shirt, olive ribbed sweater, round gold viewer-right lapel pin and source-cropped rectangular gold detail below. Serious mouth on blue backdrop. Keep moustache only/hair/brows/outfit/crop/light; short broad mascot neck, no invented tiny badge text.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal clean-shaven man under wide brown fedora with dark band, short white-grey hair/brows. Dark grey field coat, gold/olive checked scarf over grey ribbed inner shirt; source-cropped red/brown/gold book edges viewer left and tiny rectangular dark badge viewer right. Serious mouth, blue backdrop. Preserve fedora/scarf/hair/brows/books/badge and crop/light; short broad mascot neck, clean upper lip and chin.
